name: Jarvis 38.0
notes: 📊 New SSR Performance Band report: type bands like "less than or equal to 5, 6-10, 11-15, 16-20, 21 and above" (or 1-10, 11-20… or % bands like below 5%, 10%-20%, 40% and above) by ASM-wise or TL-wise. You get a Summary sheet (SSR count, TGT, ACH, % and number of SSRs in each band), an SSR Performance sheet, one base working sheet per band and charts. Nothing else changes – the lock, unlock keys and access days work as before.
